description: Returns the closest property within 300 feet of GPS coordinates, including property details and optional contacts. A matched property costs one property credit; returned contacts can consume people credits. No credits are charged when no property matches. `contact_audience=none` returns property-only data.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts
